title: Chivalry
description: WIP resourcepack that aims to change tools, armor, weapons, etc...
body:
# About

medieval resourcepack, adds new textures, eventually will change ALL tool textures.

Current Fin textures:
- All Wooden Tools
- Stone Sword
- Copper Sword
- Gold Sword
- Iron Sword
- Diamond Sword
